tools.name: search_green_screens
tools.description: Search green screen meme clips by words (matched against names, tags and descriptions). Leave query empty to get the newest. Returns ids, names, descriptions, thumbnails and video links.

tools.name: get_green_screen
tools.description: One green screen clip by id, with its video link and an ffmpeg recipe for compositing it over an image or video.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: What people are using right now in the Green Screen Memes app, most popular first. Each clip has its trending rank (1 = most popular), plus the same fields as search results.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Curated collections of green screens, including "trending" (what people are using right now in the app; get_trending returns it directly).

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: The green screens in one collection, in order. Use id "trending" for the current trending clips.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: The most used tags with how many green screens have each, to see what the library covers.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: This API key's plan and how much of this month's calls and video downloads it has used.
